title: Fix session start hook paths for _framework files
description: Hook at .claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit.sh expects files at WAI-Spoke/_framework/ but they are at WAI-Spoke/reference/auto/_framework/. Need to either: (1) create _framework/ and copy files there, or (2) update template generation to create this structure automatically.

title: Code cleanup: Remove deprecated/vestigial code from framework
description: Audit framework codebase for deprecated code paths, unused imports, old patterns that contradict current design. Examples: references to teach as a spoke command (removed), old YOLO vs ADAPTIVE transition code, obsolete testing patterns. Create cleanup checklist ensuring all changes covered by existing test suite. This is ideal downtime/low-context work.

title: Reimplement WAI CLI with cleaner architecture
description: Current menu system is hard to test and maintain. Multiple menu functions with complex state management, nested loops, and interconnected navigation. Errors slip through (like b-menu not working). Reimplement using: (1) Single unified menu router (not 10 functions), (2) Command pattern for actions, (3) Full test coverage before release, (4) CLI state machine that doesnt rely on function nesting. Update version to 3.0.0.

title: Test Coverage Review & Gap Analysis
description: Audit test suite: unit tests, integration tests, smoke tests. Identify gaps. Plan coverage improvements. Review testing pyramid - do we have right ratio of unit:integration:e2e? Current status: pexpect import missing blocks integration tests.

title: Codebase Structure & Architecture Review
description: Review code organization: is wai/ module structure clear? Are responsibilities well-separated? Check for cyclic imports, deep nesting, unclear abstractions. Plan refactoring if needed. Related: CLI reimplementation epic (c7f2e9a4b1d6) identifies menu system as problematic.

title: Security & Input Validation Audit
description: Review security posture: input validation on all user inputs? Path traversal protection? Hub discovery security? Check for hardcoded credentials. Review hub-profile.json signing/verification. Plan hardening where needed.

title: Documentation & Help System Review
description: Review all help text, command docs, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md for accuracy and completeness. Check for stale references. Verify examples work. Plan doc improvements and user guides.

title: Implement Teaching Reconciliation on Session Events
description: Add automatic reconciliation trigger for teach files on: (1) New session start - detect .teaching files, show briefing, propose adoption, (2) WAI wakeup hook - list pending teachings, (3) Closeout - process taught files into reference/auto, reconcile with current versions, prompt for adoption decisions. Success: Users see pending teachings on session start and can adopt or defer.

title: Upgrade Adoption Plan with Hub Fingerprint Verification
description: Implement upgrade-adoption-plan.json (replaces teaching-adoption-plan.json) with: (1) Hub fingerprint signing for security, (2) File hashes for integrity, (3) Context fields (why_changed, mentions, applies_to) for AI decision-making, (4) Version info for relevance. See UPGRADE-ADOPTION-PLAN-SPEC.md. Enables secure, verified knowledge synchronization.

title: Hub Templates - Extend Templates to HUB Directory
description: Create templates/HUB/ with hub-specific files: hub-profile.json (identity, fingerprint), hub-registry.json (project registry), hub-learning-index.md (knowledge base index), hub-security-policy.json, AGENTS.md. Hub becomes a spoke with additional features. Enables universal teach/learn: hub and spokes use same protocol, same adoption workflow.

title: Universal Teach/Learn Protocol - Hub + Spokes Unified
description: Unify teach/learn across hub and spokes: (1) Both hub and spokes receive upgrade-adoption-plan.json, (2) Both use same verification & adoption logic, (3) Both export knowledge back (hub learns from all spokes), (4) Bidirectional communication enables standardization & network effects. Success: Hub and spoke speak same language, knowledge flows in both directions.

title: Phase 4: Implement Spoke ID System for Cross-Project Integrity
description: Implement spoke_id (12-character hex) system for each wheel to detect cross-project file conflicts. Enables hub to validate file origins and warn on mismatches. (1) ✓ wai/spoke_id.py - generation, validation, registry (17 unit tests passing). (2) ✓ wai/file_validator.py - detect cross-project file conflicts. (3) ✓ Update init.py to auto-generate spoke_id for new wheels. (4) ✓ Create migrate_scf_to_wheelwright.py migration script. (5) ✓ Add spoke_id (7a1d9c5b3e2f) to wheel metadata in WAI-State.json. Success: Each wheel has unique spoke_id, file operations validate cross-project conflicts.

title: Phase 4: Spoke Auto-Discovery Scanner
description: Implement spoke auto-discovery to scan hub for all wheel projects and assign/verify spoke_ids. (1) ✓ wai/discovery.py - find all WAI-Spoke/ directories in hub recursively (9 unit tests passing). (2) ✓ Assign spoke_id to projects missing one (deterministic generation). (3) ✓ Create hub spoke registry at .WAI-registry/spokes.json. (4) ✓ Detect orphaned spokes (WAI-Spoke/ without matching hub entry). (5) ✓ Integrate into 'WAI hub scan' command in core.py. Success: User runs 'WAI hub scan', discovers all wheels, auto-assigns spoke_ids, builds registry.
